Factors of production are rarely equally productive in every use. Expansion of one good first draws resources well suited to it; further expansion requires resources with stronger productivity in the other activity, so the forgone amount rises.

If every resource has the same productivity ratio in both uses, each transfer creates the same trade-off and the PPC is a straight line. That case is a useful benchmark, while resource specificity is more common in practice.

zh-CN.title: 实证经济学
zh-CN.takeaway: 实证经济学提出关于事实、关系或因果的可检验陈述，重点是证据能否支持或反驳。
zh-CN.definition: 实证经济学描述和解释经济事实，提出原则上可通过观察、数据或实验检验真假的陈述，不以“应该怎样”的价值判断作为结论。
causalChain: 提出对事实或因果关系的陈述
把概念转化为可观察指标
收集并分析相关证据
暂时支持、修正或反驳陈述

realWorldExample.title: 公开数据允许检验增长陈述
realWorldExample.explanation: 世界银行数据平台提供增长、物价、贸易和社会指标。‘某年实际 GDP 增长率下降’可用明确口径的数据检验，属于实证陈述。

misconceptions: 实证陈述可以是错误的；“可检验”不等于“已经被证实”。
数字看似客观，但指标定义、样本和因果方法仍需判断。
examApplication: 寻找可验证动词和变量，区分‘是/会’与‘应该/更好’。
说明需要什么证据以及哪些其他因素可能混淆关系。
summary: 实证陈述涉及可观察事实或因果。
证据可以支持也可以反驳。
测量与识别方法影响结论可信度。
zh-CN.explanation:
实证分析试图说明经济是什么样以及变量如何关联。例如‘提高某税率会降低消费量’是一个可检验预测，即使研究最终发现消费量没有下降，它仍属于实证命题。

检验并不总是简单。变量可能同时受到收入、政策和预期影响。研究者需要定义指标、选择比较对象并处理其他因素，才能把相关性与因果解释区分开。

en.title: Positive economics
en.takeaway: Positive economics makes testable claims about facts, relationships, or causes and asks whether evidence supports or challenges them.
en.definition: Positive economics describes and explains economic reality through statements that can in principle be tested with observation, data, or experiments, without concluding what ought to be done from a value judgement.
causalChain: State a claim about a fact or causal relationship
Translate concepts into observable measures
Collect and analyse relevant evidence
Provisionally support, revise, or reject the claim

realWorldExample.title: Open data permit a growth claim to be tested
realWorldExample.explanation: The World Bank data platform publishes growth, price, trade, and social indicators. A claim that real GDP growth fell in a specified year can be checked against a defined measure and is positive.

misconceptions: A positive statement can be false; testable does not mean already proven.
Numbers appear objective, but definitions, samples, and causal methods still require judgement.
examApplication: Look for measurable variables and distinguish is or will from should or better.
State what evidence would be needed and which other factors could confound the relationship.
summary: Positive claims concern observable facts or causes.
Evidence can support or refute them.
Measurement and identification affect credibility.
en.explanation:
Positive analysis asks what the economy is like and how variables relate. The prediction that a higher tax will reduce consumption is testable and remains a positive proposition even if research eventually finds no reduction.

Testing is rarely automatic. Income, other policies, and expectations may change at the same time. Researchers define measures, choose comparison groups, and address alternative explanations to distinguish correlation from a credible causal account.

zh-CN.title: 规范经济学与价值判断
zh-CN.takeaway: 规范经济学讨论经济应当怎样；事实能说明后果，却不能单独决定应优先追求哪一种价值。
zh-CN.definition: 规范经济学根据公平、自由、效率、可持续性或福祉等价值标准，对政策、制度或结果作出“应该”“更好”或“可取”的判断。
causalChain: 社会面对多个可能目标
价值判断确定目标的相对重要性
实证证据预测各方案的后果
决策者依标准权衡并形成规范结论

realWorldExample.title: 最低工资讨论包含事实与价值
realWorldExample.explanation: 国际劳工组织的最低工资资料同时涉及工资保障、就业、覆盖和执行。就业影响属于可检验问题，而‘更公平的工资是否值得某些成本’包含价值判断。

misconceptions: 规范陈述不等于没有逻辑或证据；它应公开价值标准并使用可靠事实。
实证研究不能消除所有分歧，因为人们可能对同一后果赋予不同权重。
examApplication: 圈出‘应该、公平、更好、过多’等价值词并写明隐含标准。
评价政策时先陈述实证后果，再说明价值权重如何影响结论。
summary: 规范结论回答应当怎样。
价值判断选择和排序目标。
证据约束判断但不能独自决定价值。
zh-CN.explanation:
经济政策常涉及多个目标：效率、公平、稳定、选择自由和环境保护。决定哪一目标更重要，需要价值判断，因此无法只由数据推导。

规范论证仍应严谨。先用实证分析说明各方案可能产生什么结果，再公开采用的公平或福祉标准。这样即使结论不同，分歧来自事实还是价值也能被识别。

en.title: Normative economics and value judgements
en.takeaway: Normative economics asks how the economy ought to be; facts reveal consequences but cannot alone decide which values deserve priority.
en.definition: Normative economics evaluates policies, institutions, or outcomes as desirable, better, or required by applying value standards such as equity, freedom, efficiency, sustainability, or well-being.
causalChain: Society faces several possible objectives
Value judgements assign relative importance to them
Positive evidence predicts consequences of alternatives
Decision-makers weigh outcomes and reach a normative conclusion

realWorldExample.title: Minimum-wage debate combines facts and values
realWorldExample.explanation: International Labour Organization material on minimum wages covers wage protection, employment, coverage, and enforcement. Employment effects are testable; whether greater wage fairness justifies a cost includes a value judgement.

misconceptions: A normative claim need not be illogical or evidence-free; it should disclose its value standard and use credible facts.
Positive research cannot remove every disagreement because people may attach different weights to the same consequences.
examApplication: Identify value language such as should, fair, better, or excessive and state the implied criterion.
Present positive consequences first, then explain how value weights influence the final judgement.
summary: Normative conclusions address what ought to be.
Value judgements select and rank objectives.
Evidence constrains a judgement without determining its values.
en.explanation:
Economic policy commonly pursues several goals: efficiency, equity, stability, freedom of choice, and environmental protection. Ranking those goals requires a value judgement and cannot be deduced from data alone.

Normative reasoning can still be disciplined. Positive analysis first estimates the consequences of each option, and the fairness or welfare criterion is then made explicit. This allows disagreement about evidence to be separated from disagreement about values.

zh-CN.title: 逻辑、假设、理论与模型
zh-CN.takeaway: 经济研究从逻辑一致的假设推导预测，用模型表达机制，再以证据检验和改进理论。
zh-CN.definition: 假设是可检验的暂时命题，理论是解释一组现象的连贯关系体系，模型是理论的简化表达，而逻辑保证从前提到结论的推导一致。
causalChain: 观察现象并提出问题
形成假设和机制解释
把关键关系表达为模型并推导预测
用证据检验后保留、修正或替代理论

realWorldExample.title: 政策评价连接理论与证据
realWorldExample.explanation: OECD 的政策评价资料强调明确政策目标、变化理论、指标和反事实。只有把政策如何产生结果的逻辑写清，证据才能针对关键假设。

misconceptions: 理论不是随意猜测，而是能组织解释和预测的体系。
逻辑正确只表示结论能从前提推出，并不证明前提符合现实。
examApplication: 把答案写成前提—机制—预测—证据链。
评价模型时分别检查内部逻辑与外部经验有效性。
summary: 逻辑连接前提与结论。
假设提出可检验命题。
理论和模型需通过证据不断修正。
zh-CN.explanation:
经济解释通常始于一个观察到的规律或问题。研究者提出可能机制，明确假设，再用模型推导如果机制成立应观察到什么。

内部一致性与经验有效性是不同检验。一个模型可以逻辑严密但建立在不适合某情境的假设上；也可能产生吻合数据的预测，却没有正确识别因果机制。两者都需要审查。

en.title: Logic, hypotheses, theories, and models
en.takeaway: Economic inquiry derives predictions from logically consistent assumptions, represents mechanisms in models, and uses evidence to test and improve theory.
en.definition: A hypothesis is a provisional testable proposition; a theory is a coherent system of relationships that explains phenomena; a model is a simplified representation of theory; and logic makes inference from premises to conclusions internally consistent.
causalChain: Observe a pattern and pose a question
Form a hypothesis and proposed mechanism
Represent key relationships in a model and derive predictions
Use evidence to retain, revise, or replace the theory

realWorldExample.title: Policy evaluation connects theory and evidence
realWorldExample.explanation: OECD material on policy evaluation stresses clear objectives, a theory of change, indicators, and a counterfactual. Evidence can address key assumptions only after the logic connecting policy to outcome is explicit.

misconceptions: A theory is not a casual guess; it is a system capable of organising explanation and prediction.
Valid logic shows that a conclusion follows from premises, not that the premises accurately represent reality.
examApplication: Structure an explanation as premises, mechanism, prediction, and evidence.
Evaluate internal logical consistency separately from external empirical validity.
summary: Logic links premises to conclusions.
A hypothesis states a testable proposition.
Evidence drives revision of theories and models.
en.explanation:
An economic explanation often begins with an observed pattern or puzzle. A researcher proposes a mechanism, states assumptions, and builds a model to derive what should be observed if the mechanism operates.

Internal consistency and empirical validity are different tests. A model may be logically sound but rest on assumptions unsuited to a context. It can also fit a pattern in data without identifying the true causal mechanism. Both dimensions need scrutiny.

zh-CN.title: 其他条件不变
zh-CN.takeaway: ceteris paribus 暂时固定其他相关因素，以隔离一个变量的影响；现实预测必须检查这些因素是否真的相近。
zh-CN.definition: 其他条件不变（ceteris paribus）是假设除被研究变量外，其他可能影响结果的相关因素保持不变，从而分析单一关系。
causalChain: 结果同时受到多个因素影响
分析者选择一个关注变量
暂时固定其他影响因素
推导该变量变化的独立方向性影响

realWorldExample.title: 分析利率变化需要条件限定
realWorldExample.explanation: 英格兰银行说明货币政策如何通过借贷、支出和预期影响通胀。若同期能源价格或财政政策改变，观察到的通胀变化就不能只归因于利率。

misconceptions: 其他条件不变不是声称现实中其他因素不会变化。
这个假设隔离方向性关系，却不能保证实际结果大小或时间。
examApplication: 写明被固定的关键因素，而不是只在句尾加入拉丁语。
评价时指出哪个条件最可能变化并改变预测。
summary: 该假设用于隔离单一关系。
它是分析工具而非现实描述。
放松假设可形成有效评价。
zh-CN.explanation:
价格、收入、偏好和预期常同时影响选择。若要研究价格本身的作用，就暂时假设收入、偏好等因素不变，从而避免把多个影响混在一起。

应用结论时要重新面对现实。若被固定因素发生显著变化，它可能加强、抵消或反转模型预测。因此 ceteris paribus 同时告诉我们模型能做什么和不能做什么。

en.title: Ceteris paribus
en.takeaway: Ceteris paribus temporarily holds other relevant influences constant to isolate one variable; an applied prediction must ask whether those conditions are genuinely similar.
en.definition: Ceteris paribus means assuming that relevant influences other than the variable under study remain unchanged so that one relationship can be analysed separately.
causalChain: An outcome is influenced by several factors
The analyst selects one variable of interest
Other influences are temporarily held constant
The variable's independent directional effect is derived

realWorldExample.title: An interest-rate analysis requires conditions
realWorldExample.explanation: The Bank of England explains monetary transmission through borrowing, spending, and expectations. If energy prices or fiscal policy change at the same time, the observed inflation path cannot be attributed to interest rates alone.

misconceptions: Ceteris paribus does not claim that other factors remain unchanged in the real world.
It isolates a directional relationship without guaranteeing the size or timing of an actual outcome.
examApplication: Name the important factors being held constant rather than merely adding the Latin phrase.
In evaluation, identify the condition most likely to change and alter the prediction.
summary: The assumption isolates one relationship.
It is an analytical device, not a description of reality.
Relaxing it can produce effective evaluation.
en.explanation:
Price, income, preferences, and expectations can influence a choice simultaneously. To study the effect of price itself, an analyst temporarily fixes income, preferences, and other influences rather than mixing several changes together.

Application returns the analysis to reality. A substantial change in a held-constant factor can reinforce, offset, or reverse the model's prediction. Ceteris paribus therefore defines both the value and the limit of the result.

zh-CN.title: 经验证据与证伪
zh-CN.takeaway: 经验研究把理论预测与观察结果比较；反例会削弱或迫使模型修正，但单一研究很少能终结复杂争论。
zh-CN.definition: 经验证据来自系统观察、数据或实验；证伪是发现可靠证据与理论的可检验预测不一致，从而拒绝或修改该预测。
causalChain: 理论产生明确且可观察的预测
研究设计确定数据和比较方法
证据显示预测是否得到支持
不一致促使检查测量、假设或理论机制

realWorldExample.title: 随机评价建立政策反事实
realWorldExample.explanation: J-PAL 的评价资料展示随机分组如何构造没有政策时的比较结果。观察处理组与对照组差异，可检验特定情境中的因果预测。

misconceptions: 没有拒绝假设不等于证明它永远正确。
与预测不一致时既要考虑理论问题，也要检查数据质量和研究设计。
examApplication: 评价证据时检查样本、指标、反事实和外部有效性。
使用‘支持、未支持、削弱’等谨慎表述，而非绝对证明。
summary: 理论必须产生可检验预测。
研究设计决定证据能回答什么。
反驳会推动假设和模型修正。
zh-CN.explanation:
经济理论要与可观察世界连接，必须产生可能被证据否定的预测。研究者使用统计数据、自然实验、随机试验或历史比较，尝试建立可信反事实。

证据具有不确定性。测量误差、样本差异和外部条件都可能影响结果。重复研究和多种方法得到相近结论，会提高信心；相反证据则要求缩小结论范围或修正机制。

en.title: Empirical evidence and refutation
en.takeaway: Empirical work compares theoretical predictions with observation; contrary evidence weakens or forces revision of a model, although one study rarely ends a complex debate.
en.definition: Empirical evidence comes from systematic observation, data, or experiment. Refutation occurs when credible evidence conflicts with a testable theoretical prediction, requiring that prediction to be rejected or revised.
causalChain: A theory generates a clear observable prediction
Research design defines data and comparison
Evidence indicates whether the prediction is supported
Conflict prompts review of measurement, assumptions, or mechanism

realWorldExample.title: Randomised evaluation constructs a policy counterfactual
realWorldExample.explanation: J-PAL evaluations show how random assignment can create a comparison for what would have happened without a programme. Differences between treatment and control groups test a causal prediction in that setting.

misconceptions: Failing to reject a hypothesis does not prove it is permanently true.
When evidence conflicts, data quality and research design need checking alongside the theory.
examApplication: Assess a sample, measure, counterfactual, and external validity when judging evidence.
Use calibrated language such as supports, fails to support, or weakens rather than absolute proof.
summary: Theory must yield testable predictions.
Research design limits what evidence can answer.
Refutation drives revision of assumptions and models.
en.explanation:
An economic theory connects to the observable world only if it generates predictions that evidence could contradict. Statistical data, natural experiments, randomised trials, and historical comparison all help construct a credible counterfactual.

Evidence remains uncertain. Measurement error, sample differences, and context affect results. Convergence across replications and methods raises confidence, while contrary findings may narrow the domain of a claim or motivate a change in the mechanism.

zh-CN.title: 平等与公平
zh-CN.takeaway: 平等描述相同或较少差异的分配，公平判断分配是否公正；两者可以重合，也可能要求不同待遇。
zh-CN.definition: 平等是资源、机会或结果相同或差异较小的状态；公平是根据明确的公正原则判断待遇与分配是否合理。
causalChain: 观察群体间资源、机会或结果差异
确定平等指标和公平原则
判断相同待遇是否能产生公正机会
选择普遍或有针对性的政策回应

realWorldExample.title: 不平等指标与公平判断并不相同
realWorldExample.explanation: OECD 的收入分配资料可以测量群体差异，但某种差异是否公平仍取决于对需要、机会、贡献和权利的价值判断。

misconceptions: 完全相同的投入在起点不同的情况下可能无法实现公平机会。
减少一种不平等不保证其他维度的公平，例如收入更接近但服务可及性仍不同。
examApplication: 先说明讨论的是收入、财富、机会还是结果平等。
用明确公平原则解释为什么相同或不同待遇是合理的。
summary: 平等可被描述和测量。
公平需要规范性标准。
公平有时支持差别待遇以克服不同起点。
zh-CN.explanation:
平等关注差异程度，可以比较收入、财富、教育机会或健康结果。公平则进一步问这些差异是否由公正过程产生，以及政策应不应该改变它们。

相同待遇有时公平，例如同工同酬；有时有针对性的额外支持更公平，例如为存在学习障碍的学生提供资源。关键是公开比较对象、起点和原则。

en.title: Equality and equity
en.takeaway: Equality describes identical or less dispersed distributions, while equity judges whether a distribution is fair; the two may overlap or equity may require different treatment.
en.definition: Equality is a condition of sameness or smaller differences in resources, opportunities, or outcomes. Equity evaluates whether treatment and distribution are justified by an explicit principle of fairness.
causalChain: Observe differences in resources, opportunity, or outcomes
Select an equality measure and fairness principle
Ask whether identical treatment creates fair opportunity
Choose a universal or targeted policy response

realWorldExample.title: Inequality measurement differs from an equity judgement
realWorldExample.explanation: OECD income-distribution evidence measures differences across groups. Whether a measured difference is fair still depends on value judgements about need, opportunity, contribution, and rights.

misconceptions: Identical inputs may fail to create fair opportunity when starting positions differ.
Reducing one inequality does not secure equity in another dimension; incomes may converge while service access remains unequal.
examApplication: Specify whether equality concerns income, wealth, opportunity, or outcome.
Use a clear fairness principle to justify equal or differentiated treatment.
summary: Equality can be described and measured.
Equity requires a normative standard.
Equity may support differentiated treatment to address unequal starting points.
en.explanation:
Equality concerns the degree of difference and may refer to income, wealth, educational opportunity, or health outcomes. Equity goes further by asking whether differences follow from a fair process and whether policy ought to change them.

Identical treatment can be equitable, as with equal pay for equal work. Targeted support can also be equitable, as when extra resources address a learning barrier. A sound judgement makes the comparison, starting position, and principle explicit.

zh-CN.title: 亚当·斯密与自由放任
zh-CN.takeaway: 斯密强调分工、交换和竞争如何协调自利行为，但其论述并非主张完全没有法律、公共品或道德约束。
zh-CN.definition: 亚当·斯密的古典经济思想把专业化、市场交换和竞争视为财富增长的重要来源；自由放任指政府避免不必要地替代分散市场决定。
causalChain: 分工提高劳动专门化和熟练度
交换使专业化产出能够互换
价格与利润协调分散选择
竞争限制部分私人权力并推动适应

realWorldExample.title: 分工仍是现代生产网络的基础
realWorldExample.explanation: Econlib 的斯密传记介绍其关于分工、交换和制度的思想。现代供应链把任务分配给专门企业，体现生产率收益，也暴露协调与依赖风险。

misconceptions: “看不见的手”不是任何市场结果都完美的保证。
斯密承认司法、国防、公共工程和教育等国家职能，并非主张取消政府。
examApplication: 把分工—生产率—交换—市场扩大的逻辑链写完整。
评价自由放任时同时讨论竞争条件、公共品、外部性和市场权力。
summary: 分工和交换支持生产率与财富增长。
价格和竞争协调分散决定。
市场运作仍依赖制度与公共职能。
zh-CN.explanation:
斯密观察到分工可以通过熟练度、节省转换时间和促进工具创新提高产量。只要人们能够交换，生产者就可以专门化，并通过市场获得其他商品。

自由放任更适合被理解为对不必要管制和特权的怀疑，而非无政府状态。产权、合同、竞争和公共基础设施使市场协调成为可能；垄断和权力集中则会削弱其效果。

en.title: Adam Smith and laissez-faire
en.takeaway: Smith explained how specialisation, exchange, and competition can coordinate self-interested action, without arguing that law, public goods, or moral constraints are unnecessary.
en.definition: Adam Smith's classical economics treated specialisation, market exchange, and competition as important sources of growing wealth. Laissez-faire favours avoiding unnecessary state replacement of decentralised market decisions.
causalChain: Division of labour increases specialisation and skill
Exchange allows specialised outputs to be traded
Prices and profit coordinate decentralised choices
Competition constrains some private power and encourages adaptation

realWorldExample.title: Division of labour remains central to production networks
realWorldExample.explanation: The Econlib biography of Smith introduces his thinking on specialisation, exchange, and institutions. Modern supply chains divide tasks across expert firms, gaining productivity while also creating coordination and dependency risks.

misconceptions: The invisible hand is not a guarantee that every market outcome is ideal.
Smith recognised roles for justice, defence, public works, and education; he did not propose abolishing government.
examApplication: Complete the chain from specialisation to productivity, exchange, and a wider market.
Evaluation of laissez-faire should address competition, public goods, externalities, and market power.
summary: Specialisation and exchange support productivity and wealth.
Price and competition coordinate decentralised choices.
Markets still depend on institutions and public functions.
en.explanation:
Smith argued that division of labour raises output through dexterity, reduced switching time, and invention of tools. Exchange then lets producers specialise while obtaining other goods through a market.

Laissez-faire is better understood as scepticism toward unnecessary controls and privileges than as the absence of the state. Property, contracts, competition, and public infrastructure enable coordination, while monopoly and concentrated power can undermine it.

zh-CN.title: 效用理论与边际主义
zh-CN.takeaway: 边际主义用“再增加一单位”带来的收益和成本解释选择，推动价值理论从总量与生产成本转向边际评价。
zh-CN.definition: 效用理论把消费满足作为选择依据；边际主义关注一个变量微小增加所带来的额外效用、产出或成本，并以边际比较解释决策。
causalChain: 经济主体已经拥有一定数量
额外一单位带来边际收益或效用
获得该单位也产生边际成本
主体比较两者并调整直到继续改变不再有利

realWorldExample.title: 用边际思维解释用水优先顺序
realWorldExample.explanation: Econlib 对边际主义的介绍说明价值取决于额外单位的用途。水的总价值极高，但供应充足时新增一单位可能用于较低优先级用途，因此边际价值较低。

misconceptions: 边际不等于微不足道，而是指变化中的额外一单位。
总效用高并不意味着最后一单位的边际效用也高。
examApplication: 用边际收益与边际成本解释选择何时停止。
区分总量、平均量和边际量，写明所比较的新增单位。
summary: 选择发生在边际。
边际效用通常随消费增加而下降。
最优调整取决于边际收益与边际成本的比较。
zh-CN.explanation:
古典价值解释较强调生产成本。十九世纪边际主义者指出，实际选择取决于下一个单位能带来的用途与满足，而不是所有单位的总价值。

边际分析成为现代微观经济学的重要方法。消费者比较额外消费的收益和价格，企业比较额外产出的收入和成本。它不要求变化真的无限小，而要求关注选择边缘。

en.title: Utility theory and marginalism
en.takeaway: Marginalism explains choice through the benefit and cost of one more unit, shifting value theory from totals and production cost toward evaluation at the margin.
en.definition: Utility theory treats satisfaction from consumption as a basis for choice. Marginalism studies the extra utility, output, or cost created by a small increase and explains decisions through marginal comparison.
causalChain: An agent already holds or produces some quantity
One more unit creates a marginal benefit or utility
Obtaining that unit also creates marginal cost
The agent adjusts until a further change no longer improves the objective

realWorldExample.title: Marginal thinking explains priorities for water use
realWorldExample.explanation: The Econlib account of marginalism explains that value depends on the use of an additional unit. Water has enormous total value, yet when supply is abundant, the next unit may serve a low-priority use and carry a low marginal value.

misconceptions: Marginal does not mean unimportant; it means the additional unit involved in a change.
High total utility does not imply high marginal utility from the final unit.
examApplication: Use marginal benefit and marginal cost to explain where adjustment stops.
Distinguish total, average, and marginal values and identify the additional unit being compared.
summary: Choice takes place at the margin.
Marginal utility commonly falls as consumption rises.
Optimal adjustment depends on marginal benefit relative to marginal cost.
en.explanation:
Classical accounts of value placed substantial weight on production cost. Nineteenth-century marginalists argued that an actual choice depends on the use and satisfaction available from the next unit rather than the total value of all units.

Marginal analysis became a central method in modern microeconomics. Consumers compare the benefit of extra consumption with price, and firms compare extra revenue with extra cost. The change need not be literally infinitesimal; the focus is the decision edge.

zh-CN.title: 萨伊定律
zh-CN.takeaway: 萨伊定律强调生产创造收入并支持需求，因而怀疑普遍长期供给过剩；凯恩斯后来挑战了这一自我调整结论。
zh-CN.definition: 萨伊定律通常概括为供给创造相应需求：生产过程产生收入，使总体购买力能够吸收产出，因此全面持久的总需求不足不应在灵活市场中持续。
causalChain: 企业生产并支付工资、租金与利润
这些要素收入形成购买力
收入用于消费、储蓄或投资融资
价格和利率调整使总体供求重新协调

realWorldExample.title: 经济衰退检验自我调整速度
realWorldExample.explanation: Econlib 对萨伊定律的介绍讨论生产与需求的联系。严重衰退中收入可能被持有而投资不响应，这成为凯恩斯质疑自动恢复机制的关键。

misconceptions: 该命题不声称每一种商品都能自动售出，个别市场仍会供过于求。
‘供给创造需求’不是同一企业购买自己产品，而是生产创造要素收入。
examApplication: 先说明生产—收入—支出的循环机制，再讨论储蓄、预期和价格刚性。
与凯恩斯观点比较时聚焦总需求不足能否持续。
summary: 生产创造收入和潜在购买力。
古典框架依赖价格与利率调整。
储蓄不转化为投资时自我调整可能受阻。
zh-CN.explanation:
萨伊定律来自古典经济学对生产和收入循环的强调。生产商品时也向劳动者和资源所有者支付收入，因此总供给同时创造了购买力来源。

争议集中在收入是否一定及时转化为支出。若储蓄通过利率变化流向投资，全面过剩难以持续；若不确定性使储蓄增加而投资疲弱，总需求可能低于充分就业产出。

en.title: Say's Law
en.takeaway: Say's Law emphasises that production creates income and supports demand, casting doubt on a persistent general glut; Keynes later challenged the speed and reliability of that adjustment.
en.definition: Say's Law is commonly summarised as supply creating corresponding demand: production generates income, giving the economy purchasing power to absorb output, so broad and lasting deficient demand should not persist in flexible markets.
causalChain: Firms produce and pay wages, rent, and profit
Factor incomes create purchasing power
Income funds consumption or saving that can finance investment
Price and interest-rate adjustment recoordinates aggregate supply and demand

realWorldExample.title: Recession tests the speed of self-correction
realWorldExample.explanation: The Econlib discussion of Say's Law presents the link between production and demand. In a severe downturn, income may be hoarded while investment fails to respond, forming a central part of Keynes's objection to automatic recovery.

misconceptions: The proposition does not mean every particular product must sell; individual markets can have excess supply.
Supply creates demand through factor income, not because a producer buys its own product.
examApplication: Explain the production-income-spending cycle before discussing saving, expectations, and sticky prices.
A comparison with Keynes should focus on whether deficient aggregate demand can persist.
summary: Production generates income and potential purchasing power.
The classical account relies on price and interest-rate adjustment.
Self-correction can fail when saving does not become investment.
en.explanation:
Say's Law emerges from the classical emphasis on the circular connection between production and income. Producing goods also pays income to workers and resource owners, so aggregate supply creates the source of purchasing power.

The dispute concerns whether that income reliably returns as expenditure. If interest-rate adjustment channels saving into investment, a general glut should be temporary. If uncertainty raises saving while investment remains weak, aggregate demand can fall below full-employment output.

zh-CN.title: 马克思主义批判
zh-CN.takeaway: 马克思主义分析把所有权、阶级关系和资本积累置于核心，质疑市场交换表面的自由是否掩盖生产权力与分配冲突。
zh-CN.definition: 马克思主义经济批判以生产资料所有权、劳动与资本的阶级关系、剩余价值和资本积累为框架，分析资本主义的分配、权力与危机倾向。
causalChain: 生产资料集中在资本所有者手中
无产者出售劳动力获得工资
产出价值与工资之间形成剩余并被积累
积累改变权力、技术、分配并可能加剧冲突

realWorldExample.title: 平台劳动重新提出控制与剩余问题
realWorldExample.explanation: 斯坦福哲学百科的马克思条目概述异化、阶级和历史分析。数字平台中算法控制、资产所有和劳动收入的关系，可用这些问题意识研究，但具体结论仍需现代证据。

misconceptions: 马克思主义批判不只是主张收入平均，它首先分析生产关系和所有权。
历史理论不能直接替代对当代企业、劳动市场和制度的实证研究。
examApplication: 把所有权—劳动过程—剩余—积累的机制写清。
评价时比较其对权力和分配的洞察与预测、制度多样性和历史证据。
summary: 所有权结构影响生产与分配权力。
剩余和积累是分析核心。
阶级框架强调市场交换背后的生产关系。
zh-CN.explanation:
马克思把资本主义视为一种历史生产方式，而不只是独立买卖的集合。劳动者不拥有主要生产资料，因此通过出售劳动力参与生产；资本所有者控制投资与剩余使用。

该框架强调技术变化、企业集中和危机与积累过程的联系。应用时需要区分分析概念、历史预测和规范主张，并用当代制度和数据检验哪些机制仍有解释力。

en.title: The Marxist critique
en.takeaway: Marxist analysis centres ownership, class relations, and capital accumulation, questioning whether formal freedom in exchange conceals power and distributional conflict in production.
en.definition: The Marxist critique uses ownership of the means of production, class relations between labour and capital, surplus value, and accumulation to analyse distribution, power, and tendencies toward crisis in capitalism.
causalChain: Ownership of productive assets is concentrated among capital owners
Workers sell labour power for wages
A surplus between output and labour compensation is accumulated
Accumulation changes power, technology, distribution, and potential conflict

realWorldExample.title: Platform work renews questions about control and surplus
realWorldExample.explanation: The Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy entry on Marx outlines alienation, class, and historical analysis. Algorithmic control, asset ownership, and labour income in digital platforms can be studied through those questions, while modern evidence remains necessary.

misconceptions: Marxist critique is not merely a demand for equal income; it begins with production relations and ownership.
A historical theory cannot substitute directly for empirical study of current firms, labour markets, and institutions.
examApplication: Make the mechanism from ownership through labour, surplus, and accumulation explicit.
Evaluate insights about power and distribution against predictions, institutional diversity, and historical evidence.
summary: Ownership structures influence power in production and distribution.
Surplus and accumulation are central analytical ideas.
Class analysis looks behind exchange to production relations.
en.explanation:
Marx treated capitalism as a historical mode of production, not simply a collection of voluntary trades. Workers lack ownership of the main productive assets and participate by selling labour power, while capital owners control investment and the use of surplus.

The framework connects technological change, concentration, and crisis to accumulation. Application should separate analytical concepts, historical predictions, and normative positions and test which mechanisms retain explanatory value in contemporary institutions.

zh-CN.title: 凯恩斯革命与宏观政策
zh-CN.takeaway: 凯恩斯指出总需求不足可使经济长期低于充分就业，并由此奠定用财政和货币政策稳定宏观经济的框架。
zh-CN.definition: 凯恩斯主义认为支出、预期和价格工资刚性会决定短期产出与就业；当私人需求不足且自我调整缓慢时，公共政策可支持总需求。
causalChain: 悲观预期减少消费或投资
总需求下降使企业减产和裁员
收入下降进一步压低支出
逆周期财政或货币政策尝试打破收缩循环

realWorldExample.title: 衰退中的逆周期稳定政策
realWorldExample.explanation: IMF 对凯恩斯经济学的介绍说明，经济低迷时政府支出或减税可支撑需求，繁荣时则应重建财政空间；具体乘数取决于闲置资源、开放度和政策设计。

misconceptions: 凯恩斯主义不主张任何时期都扩大赤字，而强调逆周期管理。
增加支出不会机械地产生固定乘数，挤出、进口和预期会改变效果。
examApplication: 用总需求—产出—就业—收入反馈解释衰退。
评价稳定政策时讨论经济余量、乘数、时滞、债务和退出策略。
summary: 总需求可以持续低于充分就业水平。
工资价格刚性减慢自我调整。
宏观政策可稳定支出但受到条件约束。
zh-CN.explanation:
大萧条挑战了市场会迅速恢复充分就业的古典观点。凯恩斯强调企业投资取决于不确定的预期，家庭收入下降又会减少消费，使需求不足自我强化。

这套思想推动宏观经济学和稳定政策形成。政府预算、自动稳定器与中央银行政策被用于缓和周期，但政策时机、融资、通胀风险和长期供给仍需要权衡。

en.title: The Keynesian revolution and macroeconomic policy
en.takeaway: Keynes argued that deficient aggregate demand can keep an economy below full employment, establishing a framework for fiscal and monetary stabilisation policy.
en.definition: Keynesian economics holds that expenditure, expectations, and wage-price rigidity influence short-run output and employment, and that public policy can support aggregate demand when private demand is weak and self-correction is slow.
causalChain: Pessimistic expectations reduce consumption or investment
Lower aggregate demand causes firms to cut output and jobs
Falling income further reduces expenditure
Countercyclical fiscal or monetary policy seeks to interrupt the contraction

realWorldExample.title: Countercyclical stabilisation in a downturn
realWorldExample.explanation: The IMF introduction to Keynesian economics describes how public spending or tax reductions can support demand in a slump and why fiscal space should be rebuilt in stronger periods. The multiplier varies with slack, openness, and policy design.

misconceptions: Keynesian policy does not prescribe larger deficits in every period; it is countercyclical.
Additional spending does not produce a mechanically fixed multiplier because crowding out, imports, and expectations alter the effect.
examApplication: Explain recession through feedback among aggregate demand, output, employment, and income.
Evaluate stabilisation through economic slack, the multiplier, time lags, debt, and an exit strategy.
summary: Aggregate demand can remain below full-employment output.
Sticky wages and prices slow self-correction.
Macroeconomic policy can stabilise spending under important conditions.
en.explanation:
The Great Depression challenged the classical expectation of rapid return to full employment. Keynes emphasised that business investment depends on uncertain expectations and that lower household income reduces consumption, allowing deficient demand to reinforce itself.

The argument helped establish macroeconomics and stabilisation policy. Government budgets, automatic stabilisers, and central-bank action can moderate a cycle, while timing, financing, inflation risk, and long-run supply still require evaluation.

zh-CN.title: 货币主义与新古典反革命
zh-CN.takeaway: 货币主义和新古典理论重新强调货币稳定、市场调整、预期与政策可信度，并质疑积极需求管理能否持续提高实际产出。
zh-CN.definition: 货币主义强调货币供给与名义支出及通胀的长期关系；新古典宏观理论加入理性预期和市场出清，分析可预见政策为何可能被主体行为抵消。
causalChain: 政策改变货币或总需求路径
家庭和企业形成对通胀与政策的预期
工资、价格和资产选择随预期调整
长期影响更多体现为物价而非持续更高实际产出

realWorldExample.title: 中央银行把通胀预期纳入政策
realWorldExample.explanation: IMF 对货币主义的介绍强调货币增长和通胀的长期联系。现代央行会关注政策可信度与预期，因为预期可提前影响工资谈判、定价和金融条件。

misconceptions: 货币主义不等于认为货币在所有时期以固定速度影响经济。
理性预期并不表示人能完美预测，而是不会系统性忽略可用信息。
examApplication: 比较凯恩斯与货币主义时区分短期非中性和长期名义影响。
评价规则与酌情政策时讨论信息、时滞、可信度和意外冲击。
summary: 长期通胀与货币和名义需求有关。
预期会改变政策传导。
可预见需求政策难以永久提高实际产出。
zh-CN.explanation:
二十世纪后期的货币主义者批评对财政微调和稳定乘数的过度信赖，强调政策时滞与货币稳定。新古典理论进一步分析理性预期如何使人提前调整。

这些观点推动独立中央银行、通胀目标和规则可信度的讨论。现实政策通常综合多种思想：承认短期需求波动，同时重视通胀预期、供给约束和长期可持续性。

en.title: The monetarist and new classical counter-revolution
en.takeaway: Monetarist and new classical thinking renewed emphasis on monetary stability, market adjustment, expectations, and policy credibility, questioning whether activist demand management can raise real output persistently.
en.definition: Monetarism stresses the long-run relationship between money growth, nominal spending, and inflation. New classical macroeconomics adds rational expectations and market clearing to examine why predictable policy may be offset by agents' responses.
causalChain: Policy changes the path of money or aggregate demand
Households and firms form expectations about inflation and policy
Wages, prices, and asset choices adjust to those expectations
Long-run effects appear more in prices than in permanently higher real output

realWorldExample.title: Central banks incorporate inflation expectations
realWorldExample.explanation: The IMF account of monetarism emphasises the long-run connection between monetary growth and inflation. Modern central banks monitor credibility and expectations because they influence wage bargaining, pricing, and financial conditions in advance.

misconceptions: Monetarism does not claim that money affects the economy with an identical speed in every period.
Rational expectations do not mean perfect prediction; they imply that available information is not ignored systematically.
examApplication: When comparing Keynesian and monetarist views, distinguish short-run non-neutrality from long-run nominal effects.
Evaluate rules and discretion through information, lags, credibility, and unexpected shocks.
summary: Long-run inflation is linked to money and nominal demand.
Expectations alter policy transmission.
Predictable demand policy cannot permanently raise real output.
en.explanation:
Late twentieth-century monetarists criticised excessive confidence in fiscal fine-tuning and stable multipliers, drawing attention to policy lags and monetary stability. New classical models developed the role of forward-looking expectations.

These ideas shaped debates over independent central banks, inflation targets, and credible rules. Actual policymaking often combines traditions: it accepts short-run demand fluctuations while taking inflation expectations, supply constraints, and long-run sustainability seriously.

zh-CN.title: 行为经济学
zh-CN.takeaway: 行为经济学把有限理性、自我控制和社会偏好纳入模型，解释现实选择为何系统性偏离完全理性基准。
zh-CN.definition: 行为经济学结合心理学和经济学，研究启发式、偏差、有限注意、自我控制问题与社会偏好如何影响经济决策。
causalChain: 决策者面对复杂信息和认知限制
使用简化规则并受呈现方式影响
实际选择偏离标准理性模型
行为证据推动更真实的模型和政策设计

realWorldExample.title: 默认选项改变参与行为
realWorldExample.explanation: 2017 年诺贝尔经济学奖资料总结 Richard Thaler 对有限理性、社会偏好和自我控制的贡献。自动加入并允许退出的默认设计常能改变储蓄或参与率。

misconceptions: 行为经济学不是说人总是不理性，而是偏差在特定条件下具有可预测模式。
助推不一定无害；选择架构也涉及透明度、操控和分配问题。
examApplication: 识别具体偏差及其如何改变传统模型预测。
评价行为政策时比较有效性、自由、透明度和长期学习。
summary: 认知和自我控制限制会影响选择。
框架与默认选项可改变行为。
行为证据扩展而非简单替代传统经济模型。
zh-CN.explanation:
标准模型常把决策者视为信息充分、偏好稳定且能一致优化。行为研究通过实验和现实数据发现，损失厌恶、现状偏好、有限注意和社会规范会系统性影响选择。

这些发现既用于解释，也用于政策设计。改变表格、提醒或默认选项可能改善结果，但政策制定者必须检验不同群体反应，并保护知情选择。

en.title: Behavioural economics
en.takeaway: Behavioural economics incorporates bounded rationality, self-control, and social preferences to explain systematic departures from a fully rational benchmark.
en.definition: Behavioural economics combines psychology and economics to study how heuristics, biases, limited attention, self-control problems, and social preferences shape economic decisions.
causalChain: Decision-makers face complexity and cognitive limits
They use shortcuts and respond to framing
Observed choices depart from the standard rational benchmark
Behavioural evidence informs richer models and policy design

realWorldExample.title: Default options change participation
realWorldExample.explanation: The 2017 Nobel Prize material summarises Richard Thaler's work on limited rationality, social preferences, and self-control. Automatic enrolment with an option to leave often changes saving or participation rates.

misconceptions: Behavioural economics does not claim that people are always irrational; it identifies predictable patterns under particular conditions.
A nudge is not automatically benign; choice architecture raises questions of transparency, manipulation, and distribution.
examApplication: Identify a specific bias and show how it changes the standard model's prediction.
Evaluate behavioural policy through effectiveness, freedom, transparency, and long-run learning.
summary: Cognitive and self-control limits affect choice.
Framing and defaults can change behaviour.
Behavioural evidence extends rather than simply replaces standard models.
en.explanation:
Standard models often represent agents as informed, consistent optimisers with stable preferences. Experiments and field evidence reveal systematic effects from loss aversion, status-quo bias, limited attention, and social norms.

The findings inform both explanation and intervention. A different form, reminder, or default can improve an outcome, but policymakers still need to test responses across groups and preserve informed choice.

zh-CN.title: 相互依存与循环经济
zh-CN.takeaway: 循环经济把经济、社会与环境视为相互依存系统，通过减少材料投入、延长使用和回收价值来替代“开采—生产—丢弃”。
zh-CN.definition: 循环经济是一种设计和组织生产消费的框架，目标是减少资源开采和废弃物，在产品、部件和材料层级维持价值，并促进自然系统恢复。
causalChain: 线性生产开采资源并产生废弃物
设计减少材料并延长产品寿命
维修、再用、再制造和回收形成闭环
较低原生资源需求减轻生态压力并改变商业模式

realWorldExample.title: 联合国环境署推动循环性
realWorldExample.explanation: 联合国环境署的循环性工作把资源开采、气候、生物多样性和污染联系起来，强调产品设计、商业模式和公共政策需要协同，而不仅是末端回收。

misconceptions: 循环经济不等于只增加回收；优先级通常从避免、减量和再用开始。
循环过程也使用能源和资源，不可能在所有材料上实现百分之百闭环。
examApplication: 从产品生命周期追踪资源、价值和废弃物流。
评价时讨论设计激励、基础设施、消费者行为、反弹效应和公平转型。
summary: 经济活动依赖社会与自然系统。
循环策略在废弃前保留产品和材料价值。
实现循环需要企业、消费者和政府协作。
zh-CN.explanation:
线性模式从环境取出材料，生产、消费后把残余排回环境。循环框架尝试在设计阶段减少投入，让产品可维护、可共享、可再制造，并在最后回收材料。

循环转型展示相互依存：企业需要回收网络和稳定标准，消费者需要便利与信息，政府可用产品责任、采购和定价政策改变激励。最终成效取决于全生命周期资源节约，而不是单一回收率。

en.title: Interdependence and the circular economy
en.takeaway: A circular economy treats the economy, society, and environment as interdependent systems and replaces take-make-dispose with lower material use, longer use, and retained value.
en.definition: A circular economy is a framework for designing and organising production and consumption to reduce extraction and waste, retain value in products, components, and materials, and support regeneration of natural systems.
causalChain: Linear production extracts resources and generates waste
Design reduces material use and extends product life
Repair, reuse, remanufacture, and recycling create loops
Lower primary-resource demand reduces ecological pressure and changes business models

realWorldExample.title: UN Environment Programme promotes circularity
realWorldExample.explanation: UNEP work on circularity links resource extraction to climate, biodiversity, and pollution. It emphasises coordinated product design, business models, and public policy rather than relying only on end-of-pipe recycling.

misconceptions: A circular economy is not simply more recycling; prevention, reduction, and reuse usually come first.
Circular processes also use energy and resources, so a perfect loop for every material is not realistic.
examApplication: Trace resource, value, and waste flows across the whole product life cycle.
Evaluate design incentives, infrastructure, consumer behaviour, rebound effects, and a just transition.
summary: Economic activity depends on social and natural systems.
Circular strategies preserve product and material value before disposal.
Firms, consumers, and governments must coordinate the transition.
en.explanation:
A linear model extracts material from the environment, produces and consumes, and returns residuals as waste. Circular design reduces inputs, makes products maintainable and shareable, supports remanufacture, and recovers materials at the end.

The transition demonstrates interdependence. Firms need collection networks and stable standards, consumers need convenience and information, and government can reshape incentives through producer responsibility, procurement, and pricing. Success depends on life-cycle resource savings rather than a recycling rate alone.

zh-CN.title: 需求与需求量
zh-CN.takeaway: 需求是消费者在给定时期、不同价格下愿意且能够购买的数量关系；需求量是其中某一个价格对应的数量。
zh-CN.definition: 需求是消费者在给定时期、不同价格下愿意且能够购买的数量关系；需求量是其中某一个价格对应的数量。
causalChain: 愿望需要购买能力支持
固定收入等条件
价格改变时沿同一需求曲线移动
misconceptions: 想买但无力支付的数量不属于有效需求。
examApplication: 画图区分沿曲线移动与移动曲线，并明确其他条件。
summary: 需求是消费者在给定时期、不同价格下愿意且能够购买的数量关系；需求量是其中某一个价格对应的数量。
想买但无力支付的数量不属于有效需求。
zh-CN.explanation:
愿望需要购买能力支持。固定收入等条件。价格改变时沿同一需求曲线移动。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：咖啡从每杯 6 元降到 4 元，某人每周从买 2 杯变为 4 杯。这是需求量增加。若收入和偏好没有变，不能把它画成需求曲线右移。

想买但无力支付的数量不属于有效需求。

画图区分沿曲线移动与移动曲线，并明确其他条件。

en.title: Demand and quantity demanded
en.takeaway: Demand relates the quantities consumers are willing and able to buy at different prices during a specified period. Quantity demanded is the quantity at one particular price.
en.definition: Demand relates the quantities consumers are willing and able to buy at different prices during a specified period. Quantity demanded is the quantity at one particular price.
causalChain: Willingness requires purchasing power
hold income and other conditions constant
a price change moves the buyer along the same demand curve
misconceptions: Wanting a good without the ability to pay does not constitute effective demand.
examApplication: Distinguish movements along demand from shifts and state the ceteris paribus assumptions.
summary: Demand relates the quantities consumers are willing and able to buy at different prices during a specified period. Quantity demanded is the quantity at one particular price.
Wanting a good without the ability to pay does not constitute effective demand.
en.explanation:
Willingness requires purchasing power.  hold income and other conditions constant.  a price change moves the buyer along the same demand curve.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: coffee falls from 6 to 4 per cup and weekly purchases rise from two to four. Quantity demanded rises. With income and tastes unchanged, this is a movement along the curve, not a rightward shift.

Wanting a good without the ability to pay does not constitute effective demand.

Distinguish movements along demand from shifts and state the ceteris paribus assumptions.

zh-CN.title: 需求定律
zh-CN.takeaway: 其他条件不变时，商品价格上升通常导致需求量减少，价格下降通常导致需求量增加。
zh-CN.definition: 其他条件不变时，商品价格上升通常导致需求量减少，价格下降通常导致需求量增加。
causalChain: 价格上升提高购买的机会成本
消费者转向相对便宜的替代品
给定收入的实际购买力下降
misconceptions: 曲线向下倾斜是有条件的关系，不能把相关性当成无条件因果。
examApplication: 画图区分沿曲线移动与移动曲线，并明确其他条件。
summary: 其他条件不变时，商品价格上升通常导致需求量减少，价格下降通常导致需求量增加。
曲线向下倾斜是有条件的关系，不能把相关性当成无条件因果。
zh-CN.explanation:
价格上升提高购买的机会成本。消费者转向相对便宜的替代品。给定收入的实际购买力下降。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：公交票价提高而地铁票价不变，一些乘客改乘地铁。解释价格反应时应保持两种服务质量和收入不变；若同时改善公交服务，就无法只凭购买量判断价格效应。

曲线向下倾斜是有条件的关系，不能把相关性当成无条件因果。

画图区分沿曲线移动与移动曲线，并明确其他条件。

en.title: The law of demand
en.takeaway: Ceteris paribus, a higher price normally reduces quantity demanded and a lower price increases it.
en.definition: Ceteris paribus, a higher price normally reduces quantity demanded and a lower price increases it.
causalChain: A price rise increases the opportunity cost of buying
consumers substitute toward relatively cheaper goods
purchasing power falls at a given money income
misconceptions: A downward slope is a conditional relationship, not unconditional causation inferred from correlation.
examApplication: Distinguish movements along demand from shifts and state the ceteris paribus assumptions.
summary: Ceteris paribus, a higher price normally reduces quantity demanded and a lower price increases it.
A downward slope is a conditional relationship, not unconditional causation inferred from correlation.
en.explanation:
A price rise increases the opportunity cost of buying.  consumers substitute toward relatively cheaper goods.  purchasing power falls at a given money income.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: a bus fare rises while the train fare stays unchanged, so some passengers switch. Hold service quality and income constant to isolate the price effect. A simultaneous quality improvement would confound the inference.

A downward slope is a conditional relationship, not unconditional causation inferred from correlation.

Distinguish movements along demand from shifts and state the ceteris paribus assumptions.

zh-CN.title: 需求的非价格决定因素
zh-CN.takeaway: 收入、偏好、相关商品价格、预期和购买者数量变化，会改变每一个价格下的需求量，从而移动需求曲线。
zh-CN.definition: 收入、偏好、相关商品价格、预期和购买者数量变化，会改变每一个价格下的需求量，从而移动需求曲线。
causalChain: 一个非自身价格因素改变
相同价格下购买意愿或能力改变
整条需求曲线移动
misconceptions: 收入上升对劣等品可能使需求左移，不能一概画右移。
examApplication: 画图区分沿曲线移动与移动曲线，并明确其他条件。
summary: 收入、偏好、相关商品价格、预期和购买者数量变化，会改变每一个价格下的需求量，从而移动需求曲线。
收入上升对劣等品可能使需求左移，不能一概画右移。
zh-CN.explanation:
一个非自身价格因素改变。相同价格下购买意愿或能力改变。整条需求曲线移动。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：茶和咖啡是替代品。茶变贵会使咖啡需求右移；咖啡机和咖啡是互补品，咖啡机变贵可能使咖啡需求左移。必须明确分析的是哪一种商品。

收入上升对劣等品可能使需求左移，不能一概画右移。

画图区分沿曲线移动与移动曲线，并明确其他条件。

en.title: Non-price determinants of demand
en.takeaway: Income, tastes, related-good prices, expectations and the number of buyers can change quantity demanded at every price, shifting demand.
en.definition: Income, tastes, related-good prices, expectations and the number of buyers can change quantity demanded at every price, shifting demand.
causalChain: A determinant other than own price changes
willingness or ability changes at the same price
the whole demand curve shifts
misconceptions: Higher income can shift demand for an inferior good left, so income increases do not always shift demand right.
examApplication: Distinguish movements along demand from shifts and state the ceteris paribus assumptions.
summary: Income, tastes, related-good prices, expectations and the number of buyers can change quantity demanded at every price, shifting demand.
Higher income can shift demand for an inferior good left, so income increases do not always shift demand right.
en.explanation:
A determinant other than own price changes.  willingness or ability changes at the same price.  the whole demand curve shifts.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: tea and coffee are substitutes, so dearer tea shifts coffee demand right. Coffee machines and coffee are complements, so dearer machines may shift coffee demand left. Always name the market being analysed.

Higher income can shift demand for an inferior good left, so income increases do not always shift demand right.

Distinguish movements along demand from shifts and state the ceteris paribus assumptions.

zh-CN.title: 个人需求与市场需求
zh-CN.takeaway: 市场需求是在同一个价格下，将市场内各消费者的个人需求量相加得到的总需求关系。
zh-CN.definition: 市场需求是在同一个价格下，将市场内各消费者的个人需求量相加得到的总需求关系。
causalChain: 先固定一个价格
加总每个消费者的需求量
在其他价格重复以形成市场曲线
misconceptions: 市场需求不是各人的平均需求，也不是竖直相加价格。
examApplication: 画图区分沿曲线移动与移动曲线，并明确其他条件。
summary: 市场需求是在同一个价格下，将市场内各消费者的个人需求量相加得到的总需求关系。
市场需求不是各人的平均需求，也不是竖直相加价格。
zh-CN.explanation:
先固定一个价格。加总每个消费者的需求量。在其他价格重复以形成市场曲线。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：价格为 5 元时，甲需求 3 个、乙需求 7 个，市场需求量为 10 个。价格为 8 元时，两人可能只买 1 个和 2 个，市场需求量为 3 个。价格不能相加。

市场需求不是各人的平均需求，也不是竖直相加价格。

画图区分沿曲线移动与移动曲线，并明确其他条件。

en.title: Individual and market demand
en.takeaway: Market demand is the horizontal sum of individual quantities demanded at each common price.
en.definition: Market demand is the horizontal sum of individual quantities demanded at each common price.
causalChain: Fix a common price
add each consumer's quantity demanded
repeat at other prices to construct market demand
misconceptions: Market demand is neither average individual demand nor a vertical sum of prices.
examApplication: Distinguish movements along demand from shifts and state the ceteris paribus assumptions.
summary: Market demand is the horizontal sum of individual quantities demanded at each common price.
Market demand is neither average individual demand nor a vertical sum of prices.
en.explanation:
Fix a common price.  add each consumer's quantity demanded.  repeat at other prices to construct market demand.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: at a price of 5, A buys three units and B buys seven, so market quantity demanded is ten. At a price of 8 they may buy one and two, yielding three. Add quantities, never prices.

Market demand is neither average individual demand nor a vertical sum of prices.

Distinguish movements along demand from shifts and state the ceteris paribus assumptions.

zh-CN.title: 边际效用与消费者选择
zh-CN.takeaway: 边际效用是多消费一单位商品带来的额外满足；边际效用递减指其他条件不变时，连续增加消费带来的额外满足下降。
zh-CN.definition: 边际效用是多消费一单位商品带来的额外满足；边际效用递减指其他条件不变时，连续增加消费带来的额外满足下降。
causalChain: 连续单位满足越来越不迫切的用途
额外效用下降
消费者比较每单位支出的边际效用
misconceptions: 边际效用递减不等于总效用递减。
examApplication: 画图区分沿曲线移动与移动曲线，并明确其他条件。
summary: 边际效用是多消费一单位商品带来的额外满足；边际效用递减指其他条件不变时，连续增加消费带来的额外满足下降。
边际效用递减不等于总效用递减。
zh-CN.explanation:
连续单位满足越来越不迫切的用途。额外效用下降。消费者比较每单位支出的边际效用。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：连续三杯饮料的边际效用为 12、8、3，总效用为 23。边际效用下降时，总效用仍可上升。理性分配预算时比较 MU/P；MU 不是可以直接观察的客观幸福指标。

边际效用递减不等于总效用递减。

画图区分沿曲线移动与移动曲线，并明确其他条件。

en.title: Marginal utility and consumer choice
en.takeaway: Marginal utility is the extra satisfaction from an additional unit. Diminishing marginal utility means this extra satisfaction falls as consumption increases, ceteris paribus.
en.definition: Marginal utility is the extra satisfaction from an additional unit. Diminishing marginal utility means this extra satisfaction falls as consumption increases, ceteris paribus.
causalChain: Successive units satisfy less urgent uses
extra utility falls
consumers compare marginal utility per unit of spending
misconceptions: Diminishing marginal utility is not the same as diminishing total utility.
examApplication: Distinguish movements along demand from shifts and state the ceteris paribus assumptions.
summary: Marginal utility is the extra satisfaction from an additional unit. Diminishing marginal utility means this extra satisfaction falls as consumption increases, ceteris paribus.
Diminishing marginal utility is not the same as diminishing total utility.
en.explanation:
Successive units satisfy less urgent uses.  extra utility falls.  consumers compare marginal utility per unit of spending.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: three drinks yield marginal utilities of 12, 8 and 3, giving total utility of 23. Total utility rises despite falling marginal utility. Rational budget allocation compares MU/P, although utility is not an objectively observable happiness measure.

Diminishing marginal utility is not the same as diminishing total utility.

Distinguish movements along demand from shifts and state the ceteris paribus assumptions.

zh-CN.title: 供给与供给量
zh-CN.takeaway: 供给是生产者在给定时期、不同价格下愿意且能够出售的数量关系；供给量是某一个价格下的数量。
zh-CN.definition: 供给是生产者在给定时期、不同价格下愿意且能够出售的数量关系；供给量是某一个价格下的数量。
causalChain: 其他生产条件保持不变
价格上升提高额外生产的收益
供给量通常沿原曲线增加
misconceptions: 供给不等于仓库存货；存货只有在相应价格下愿意出售才进入供给。
examApplication: 写清商品自身价格、成本与时间的不同作用。
summary: 供给是生产者在给定时期、不同价格下愿意且能够出售的数量关系；供给量是某一个价格下的数量。
供给不等于仓库存货；存货只有在相应价格下愿意出售才进入供给。
zh-CN.explanation:
其他生产条件保持不变。价格上升提高额外生产的收益。供给量通常沿原曲线增加。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：蛋糕价格从 20 升到 25 元，糕点师延长工作时间而多做 10 个。若投入价格和技术未变，这是沿供给曲线移动，不是供给曲线右移。

供给不等于仓库存货；存货只有在相应价格下愿意出售才进入供给。

写清商品自身价格、成本与时间的不同作用。

en.title: Supply and quantity supplied
en.takeaway: Supply relates quantities producers are willing and able to sell at different prices during a period. Quantity supplied is the quantity at one price.
en.definition: Supply relates quantities producers are willing and able to sell at different prices during a period. Quantity supplied is the quantity at one price.
causalChain: Hold production conditions constant
a higher price increases the return on extra production
quantity supplied normally rises along the curve
misconceptions: Supply is not simply inventory; inventory enters supply when the producer is willing to sell it at the relevant price.
examApplication: Separate own price, costs and time when explaining supply.
summary: Supply relates quantities producers are willing and able to sell at different prices during a period. Quantity supplied is the quantity at one price.
Supply is not simply inventory; inventory enters supply when the producer is willing to sell it at the relevant price.
en.explanation:
Hold production conditions constant.  a higher price increases the return on extra production.  quantity supplied normally rises along the curve.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: cake prices rise from 20 to 25 and a baker works longer to make ten more. With input prices and technology unchanged, this is a movement along supply, not a shift.

Supply is not simply inventory; inventory enters supply when the producer is willing to sell it at the relevant price.

Separate own price, costs and time when explaining supply.

zh-CN.title: 供给的非价格决定因素
zh-CN.takeaway: 投入成本、技术、税补、生产者数量、相关产品价格及自然条件改变，可移动整个供给曲线。
zh-CN.definition: 投入成本、技术、税补、生产者数量、相关产品价格及自然条件改变，可移动整个供给曲线。
causalChain: 单位生产成本或生产能力改变
相同产品价格下生产意愿改变
供给向右或向左移动
misconceptions: 成本变化移动供给，自身价格变化通常沿供给移动。
examApplication: 写清商品自身价格、成本与时间的不同作用。
summary: 投入成本、技术、税补、生产者数量、相关产品价格及自然条件改变，可移动整个供给曲线。
成本变化移动供给，自身价格变化通常沿供给移动。
zh-CN.explanation:
单位生产成本或生产能力改变。相同产品价格下生产意愿改变。供给向右或向左移动。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：面粉价格上升提高面包成本。每一个面包价格下，原先可获利的一部分产量不再可获利，所以面包供给左移。把结果画为价格不变的需求减少会混淆市场两侧。

成本变化移动供给，自身价格变化通常沿供给移动。

写清商品自身价格、成本与时间的不同作用。

en.title: Non-price determinants of supply
en.takeaway: Input costs, technology, taxes and subsidies, producer numbers, related-product prices and natural conditions can shift the entire supply curve.
en.definition: Input costs, technology, taxes and subsidies, producer numbers, related-product prices and natural conditions can shift the entire supply curve.
causalChain: Unit costs or productive capacity change
willingness to produce changes at the same output price
supply shifts right or left
misconceptions: Changing costs shifts supply; changing the output's own price normally moves along supply.
examApplication: Separate own price, costs and time when explaining supply.
summary: Input costs, technology, taxes and subsidies, producer numbers, related-product prices and natural conditions can shift the entire supply curve.
Changing costs shifts supply; changing the output's own price normally moves along supply.
en.explanation:
Unit costs or productive capacity change.  willingness to produce changes at the same output price.  supply shifts right or left.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: dearer flour raises bread production costs. At each bread price, some previously profitable output becomes unprofitable, shifting bread supply left. Showing this as a demand reduction confuses the two sides of the market.

Changing costs shifts supply; changing the output's own price normally moves along supply.

Separate own price, costs and time when explaining supply.

zh-CN.title: 市场供给与时间尺度
zh-CN.takeaway: 市场供给是在同一价格下各生产者供给量的横向加总；生产能力调整所需时间会限制这种反应。
zh-CN.definition: 市场供给是在同一价格下各生产者供给量的横向加总；生产能力调整所需时间会限制这种反应。
causalChain: 短期部分投入固定
生产者只能调整可变投入
长期可以扩建和进入市场
misconceptions: 短期和长期不是统一的月数，而是投入是否可以全部改变。
examApplication: 写清商品自身价格、成本与时间的不同作用。
summary: 市场供给是在同一价格下各生产者供给量的横向加总；生产能力调整所需时间会限制这种反应。
短期和长期不是统一的月数，而是投入是否可以全部改变。
zh-CN.explanation:
短期部分投入固定。生产者只能调整可变投入。长期可以扩建和进入市场。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：同价时甲厂供给 30 台、乙厂供给 20 台，总供给为 50 台。一个月内厂房固定，一年内可建新厂，因此不能把短期限制解释成永久无法增加产量。

短期和长期不是统一的月数，而是投入是否可以全部改变。

写清商品自身价格、成本与时间的不同作用。

en.title: Market supply and time horizons
en.takeaway: Market supply horizontally sums producers' quantities at each common price. The time needed to adjust capacity constrains that response.
en.definition: Market supply horizontally sums producers' quantities at each common price. The time needed to adjust capacity constrains that response.
causalChain: Some inputs are fixed in the short run
firms adjust variable inputs
in the long run capacity and market entry can change
misconceptions: Short and long run are defined by input flexibility, not universal calendar durations.
examApplication: Separate own price, costs and time when explaining supply.
summary: Market supply horizontally sums producers' quantities at each common price. The time needed to adjust capacity constrains that response.
Short and long run are defined by input flexibility, not universal calendar durations.
en.explanation:
Some inputs are fixed in the short run.  firms adjust variable inputs.  in the long run capacity and market entry can change.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: two firms supply 30 and 20 units at the same price, yielding market supply of 50. Buildings may be fixed for a month but adjustable over a year, so a short-run limit need not be permanent.

Short and long run are defined by input flexibility, not universal calendar durations.

Separate own price, costs and time when explaining supply.

zh-CN.title: 边际报酬递减
zh-CN.takeaway: 短期至少一个投入固定时，连续增加一种可变投入，超过某点后额外产量会下降。
zh-CN.definition: 短期至少一个投入固定时，连续增加一种可变投入，超过某点后额外产量会下降。
causalChain: 资本等投入固定
可变投入不断增加
拥挤使边际产量下降并推高边际成本
misconceptions: 报酬递减涉及固定投入，不同于长期所有投入变化的规模不经济。
examApplication: 写清商品自身价格、成本与时间的不同作用。
summary: 短期至少一个投入固定时，连续增加一种可变投入，超过某点后额外产量会下降。
报酬递减涉及固定投入，不同于长期所有投入变化的规模不经济。
zh-CN.explanation:
资本等投入固定。可变投入不断增加。拥挤使边际产量下降并推高边际成本。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：一台烤箱配 1、2、3 名工人的日产量为 10、25、35。第二名工人的边际产量为 15，第三名为 10。总产量仍在上升；技术不变是这一比较的条件。

报酬递减涉及固定投入，不同于长期所有投入变化的规模不经济。

写清商品自身价格、成本与时间的不同作用。

en.title: Diminishing marginal returns
en.takeaway: With at least one input fixed in the short run, successive additions of a variable input eventually yield less extra output.
en.definition: With at least one input fixed in the short run, successive additions of a variable input eventually yield less extra output.
causalChain: Capital or another input is fixed
variable inputs increase
crowding reduces marginal product and raises marginal cost
misconceptions: Diminishing returns concerns fixed inputs and differs from diseconomies when all inputs vary in the long run.
examApplication: Separate own price, costs and time when explaining supply.
summary: With at least one input fixed in the short run, successive additions of a variable input eventually yield less extra output.
Diminishing returns concerns fixed inputs and differs from diseconomies when all inputs vary in the long run.
en.explanation:
Capital or another input is fixed.  variable inputs increase.  crowding reduces marginal product and raises marginal cost.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: one oven with one, two and three workers produces 10, 25 and 35 units. The second worker adds 15, the third adds ten. Total output still rises. Technology must be held constant for this comparison.

Diminishing returns concerns fixed inputs and differs from diseconomies when all inputs vary in the long run.

Separate own price, costs and time when explaining supply.

zh-CN.title: 边际成本与供给决策
zh-CN.takeaway: 边际成本 MC 是多生产一单位引起的总成本增加；生产者比较额外收益与额外成本来选择产量。
zh-CN.definition: 边际成本 MC 是多生产一单位引起的总成本增加；生产者比较额外收益与额外成本来选择产量。
causalChain: 额外单位需要更多投入
边际收益超过边际成本时增产提高利润
达到合适的边际条件后停止扩张
misconceptions: 价格等于 MC 不能单独证明企业总利润为正，还需要比较价格与平均成本。
examApplication: 写清商品自身价格、成本与时间的不同作用。
summary: 边际成本 MC 是多生产一单位引起的总成本增加；生产者比较额外收益与额外成本来选择产量。
价格等于 MC 不能单独证明企业总利润为正，还需要比较价格与平均成本。
zh-CN.explanation:
额外单位需要更多投入。边际收益超过边际成本时增产提高利润。达到合适的边际条件后停止扩张。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：产量从 10 到 11，总成本从 80 到 92，MC 为 12。若该单位售价为 15，且企业接受市场价格，增产增加 3 的利润。固定成本决定是否进入，却不直接改变这一个单位的 MC。

价格等于 MC 不能单独证明企业总利润为正，还需要比较价格与平均成本。

写清商品自身价格、成本与时间的不同作用。

en.title: Marginal cost and supply decisions
en.takeaway: Marginal cost, MC, is the addition to total cost from one more unit. Producers compare incremental revenue and cost when choosing output.
en.definition: Marginal cost, MC, is the addition to total cost from one more unit. Producers compare incremental revenue and cost when choosing output.
causalChain: Extra output requires inputs
expansion increases profit when marginal revenue exceeds marginal cost
stop expanding at the relevant marginal condition
misconceptions: Price equal to MC does not prove total profit is positive; price must also be compared with average cost.
examApplication: Separate own price, costs and time when explaining supply.
summary: Marginal cost, MC, is the addition to total cost from one more unit. Producers compare incremental revenue and cost when choosing output.
Price equal to MC does not prove total profit is positive; price must also be compared with average cost.
en.explanation:
Extra output requires inputs.  expansion increases profit when marginal revenue exceeds marginal cost.  stop expanding at the relevant marginal condition.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: output rises from ten to eleven and total cost from 80 to 92, so MC is 12. At a price-taking firm's price of 15, the extra unit adds three to profit. Fixed cost matters for entry but does not directly alter this unit's MC.

Price equal to MC does not prove total profit is positive; price must also be compared with average cost.

Separate own price, costs and time when explaining supply.

zh-CN.title: 竞争市场均衡
zh-CN.takeaway: 市场均衡是在某价格下需求量等于供给量，买卖双方计划一致且没有改变价格的内生压力。
zh-CN.definition: 市场均衡是在某价格下需求量等于供给量，买卖双方计划一致且没有改变价格的内生压力。
causalChain: 买卖双方在相同价格作出计划
需求量等于供给量
市场出清但不保证结果公平
misconceptions: 均衡不意味着所有需要都被满足，也不意味着社会最优。
examApplication: 先指出变化因素，再比较新旧价格、数量与利益相关者。
summary: 市场均衡是在某价格下需求量等于供给量，买卖双方计划一致且没有改变价格的内生压力。
均衡不意味着所有需要都被满足，也不意味着社会最优。
zh-CN.explanation:
买卖双方在相同价格作出计划。需求量等于供给量。市场出清但不保证结果公平。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：价格 8 元时买方想买 60 个、卖方想卖 60 个，这是一组均衡。均衡是模型的比较基准，现实调整可能因合约、库存或信息延迟而缓慢。

均衡不意味着所有需要都被满足，也不意味着社会最优。

先指出变化因素，再比较新旧价格、数量与利益相关者。

en.title: Competitive market equilibrium
en.takeaway: Equilibrium occurs at the price where quantity demanded equals quantity supplied, making buyers' and sellers' plans compatible without endogenous pressure for price to change.
en.definition: Equilibrium occurs at the price where quantity demanded equals quantity supplied, making buyers' and sellers' plans compatible without endogenous pressure for price to change.
causalChain: Buyers and sellers plan at a common price
quantities demanded and supplied coincide
the market clears without guaranteeing equity
misconceptions: Equilibrium does not mean all needs are met or that the outcome is socially optimal.
examApplication: Identify the changed determinant before comparing prices, quantities and stakeholders.
summary: Equilibrium occurs at the price where quantity demanded equals quantity supplied, making buyers' and sellers' plans compatible without endogenous pressure for price to change.
Equilibrium does not mean all needs are met or that the outcome is socially optimal.
en.explanation:
Buyers and sellers plan at a common price.  quantities demanded and supplied coincide.  the market clears without guaranteeing equity.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: at a price of 8 buyers demand 60 units and sellers supply 60. This is an equilibrium pair. Equilibrium is a comparison benchmark; contracts, inventories and information delays can slow actual adjustment.

Equilibrium does not mean all needs are met or that the outcome is socially optimal.

Identify the changed determinant before comparing prices, quantities and stakeholders.

zh-CN.title: 短缺、过剩与价格调整
zh-CN.takeaway: 短缺是给定价格下需求量超过供给量；过剩是供给量超过需求量。在灵活价格模型中，两者分别带来涨价和降价压力。
zh-CN.definition: 短缺是给定价格下需求量超过供给量；过剩是供给量超过需求量。在灵活价格模型中，两者分别带来涨价和降价压力。
causalChain: 非均衡价格使交易计划不一致
买方竞争或卖方积压
价格调整改变双方数量
misconceptions: 短缺的大小是 Qd−Qs，不是需求量本身。
examApplication: 先指出变化因素，再比较新旧价格、数量与利益相关者。
summary: 短缺是给定价格下需求量超过供给量；过剩是供给量超过需求量。在灵活价格模型中，两者分别带来涨价和降价压力。
短缺的大小是 Qd−Qs，不是需求量本身。
zh-CN.explanation:
非均衡价格使交易计划不一致。买方竞争或卖方积压。价格调整改变双方数量。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：Qd=90、Qs=50，短缺为 40。涨价会沿需求减少需求量、沿供给增加供给量。价格管制可能阻止这一调整，因此不能假设任何短缺都会自动立即消失。

短缺的大小是 Qd−Qs，不是需求量本身。

先指出变化因素，再比较新旧价格、数量与利益相关者。

en.title: Shortages, surpluses and price adjustment
en.takeaway: A shortage means quantity demanded exceeds quantity supplied at a given price; a surplus means the reverse. In a flexible-price model they create upward and downward price pressure respectively.
en.definition: A shortage means quantity demanded exceeds quantity supplied at a given price; a surplus means the reverse. In a flexible-price model they create upward and downward price pressure respectively.
causalChain: A disequilibrium price makes trading plans incompatible
buyers compete or sellers accumulate stock
changing price adjusts quantities on both sides
misconceptions: The size of a shortage is Qd minus Qs, not quantity demanded itself.
examApplication: Identify the changed determinant before comparing prices, quantities and stakeholders.
summary: A shortage means quantity demanded exceeds quantity supplied at a given price; a surplus means the reverse. In a flexible-price model they create upward and downward price pressure respectively.
The size of a shortage is Qd minus Qs, not quantity demanded itself.
en.explanation:
A disequilibrium price makes trading plans incompatible.  buyers compete or sellers accumulate stock.  changing price adjusts quantities on both sides.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: Qd=90 and Qs=50 imply a shortage of 40. A price rise lowers quantity demanded and increases quantity supplied along the curves. Controls can prevent adjustment, so shortages need not disappear immediately.

The size of a shortage is Qd minus Qs, not quantity demanded itself.

Identify the changed determinant before comparing prices, quantities and stakeholders.

zh-CN.title: 均衡变化与同时移动
zh-CN.takeaway: 非价格因素使需求或供给移动，产生新的均衡；两条曲线同时移动时，有些方向需要比较移动幅度才能判断。
zh-CN.definition: 非价格因素使需求或供给移动，产生新的均衡；两条曲线同时移动时，有些方向需要比较移动幅度才能判断。
causalChain: 识别变化的决定因素
移动相关曲线而保持其他关系不变
比较新旧均衡价格和数量
misconceptions: 同时移动时必须保留不确定性，不能随意假定移动幅度相同。
examApplication: 先指出变化因素，再比较新旧价格、数量与利益相关者。
summary: 非价格因素使需求或供给移动，产生新的均衡；两条曲线同时移动时，有些方向需要比较移动幅度才能判断。
同时移动时必须保留不确定性，不能随意假定移动幅度相同。
zh-CN.explanation:
识别变化的决定因素。移动相关曲线而保持其他关系不变。比较新旧均衡价格和数量。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：需求和供给都右移时，均衡数量增加，但价格可能升、降或不变。只知道移动方向，不能断言价格上涨。若需求右移且供给左移，价格上涨，而数量方向不确定。

同时移动时必须保留不确定性，不能随意假定移动幅度相同。

先指出变化因素，再比较新旧价格、数量与利益相关者。

en.title: Equilibrium changes and simultaneous shifts
en.takeaway: Non-price changes shift demand or supply and produce a new equilibrium. With simultaneous shifts, some effects depend on their relative magnitudes.
en.definition: Non-price changes shift demand or supply and produce a new equilibrium. With simultaneous shifts, some effects depend on their relative magnitudes.
causalChain: Identify the changed determinant
shift the relevant curve while holding other relationships constant
compare old and new equilibrium price and quantity
misconceptions: Preserve ambiguity under simultaneous shifts rather than silently assuming equal magnitudes.
examApplication: Identify the changed determinant before comparing prices, quantities and stakeholders.
summary: Non-price changes shift demand or supply and produce a new equilibrium. With simultaneous shifts, some effects depend on their relative magnitudes.
Preserve ambiguity under simultaneous shifts rather than silently assuming equal magnitudes.
en.explanation:
Identify the changed determinant.  shift the relevant curve while holding other relationships constant.  compare old and new equilibrium price and quantity.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: when demand and supply both shift right, equilibrium quantity rises but price may rise, fall or stay unchanged. Directions alone cannot determine price. With demand right and supply left, price rises but quantity is ambiguous.

Preserve ambiguity under simultaneous shifts rather than silently assuming equal magnitudes.

Identify the changed determinant before comparing prices, quantities and stakeholders.

zh-CN.title: 价格的信号、激励与配给
zh-CN.takeaway: 价格通过传递相对稀缺信息、改变买卖激励及按支付意愿与能力分配有限商品，协调分散决策。
zh-CN.definition: 价格通过传递相对稀缺信息、改变买卖激励及按支付意愿与能力分配有限商品，协调分散决策。
causalChain: 需求相对供给增加
涨价传递稀缺信号
生产者扩张且部分消费者减少购买
misconceptions: 高价反映市场相对稀缺，并不直接衡量人的需要有多迫切。
examApplication: 先指出变化因素，再比较新旧价格、数量与利益相关者。
summary: 价格通过传递相对稀缺信息、改变买卖激励及按支付意愿与能力分配有限商品，协调分散决策。
高价反映市场相对稀缺，并不直接衡量人的需要有多迫切。

高价反映市场相对稀缺，并不直接衡量人的需要有多迫切。

en.takeaway: Prices coordinate decentralised decisions by signalling relative scarcity, changing incentives and rationing scarce goods according to willingness and ability to pay.
en.definition: Prices coordinate decentralised decisions by signalling relative scarcity, changing incentives and rationing scarce goods according to willingness and ability to pay.

A high price reflects relative market scarcity, not a direct measure of urgency of human need.

Demand rises relative to supply.  a higher price signals scarcity.  producers expand while some buyers reduce purchases.

Illustrative example: rain damages vegetables and prices rise, encouraging other farms to deliver more and buyers to economise. Ability to pay affects access, so efficient rationing and equitable distribution are distinct criteria.

en.title: Surplus and allocative efficiency
en.takeaway: Consumer surplus is willingness to pay above the price paid; producer surplus is price received above marginal supply cost. Competitive equilibrium can maximise their sum when market-failure assumptions are absent.
en.definition: Consumer surplus is willingness to pay above the price paid; producer surplus is price received above marginal supply cost. Competitive equilibrium can maximise their sum when market-failure assumptions are absent.
causalChain: Demand represents marginal benefit and supply marginal cost
units whose benefits exceed costs are traded
total surplus is maximised at MB=MC
misconceptions: Producer surplus is not identical to profit because fixed costs have not generally been deducted.
examApplication: Identify the changed determinant before comparing prices, quantities and stakeholders.
summary: Consumer surplus is willingness to pay above the price paid; producer surplus is price received above marginal supply cost. Competitive equilibrium can maximise their sum when market-failure assumptions are absent.
Producer surplus is not identical to profit because fixed costs have not generally been deducted.

Demand represents marginal benefit and supply marginal cost.  units whose benefits exceed costs are traded.  total surplus is maximised at MB=MC.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: willingness to pay is 15, price is ten and marginal cost is seven. Consumer surplus is five, producer surplus three and total surplus eight. An external pollution cost of four would make private surplus an incomplete welfare measure.

Producer surplus is not identical to profit because fixed costs have not generally been deducted.

zh-CN.title: 理性选择与有限理性
zh-CN.takeaway: 理性选择模型假设消费者偏好一致并在约束下最大化效用；有限理性强调信息、时间和处理能力限制，可能促使人选择足够满意的方案。
zh-CN.definition: 理性选择模型假设消费者偏好一致并在约束下最大化效用；有限理性强调信息、时间和处理能力限制，可能促使人选择足够满意的方案。

可比较的选项很多。搜索和计算有成本。消费者采用简化规则或满意方案。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：购买手机时，不可能逐一比较所有品牌的每个参数。消费者可能先设价格上限和最低电池时长，再选第一个达标产品。这个策略节约决策成本，但未必最大化模型中的效用。

有限理性不是说人没有目标或随机选择。

en.title: Rational choice and bounded rationality
en.takeaway: Rational choice assumes consistent preferences and utility maximisation subject to constraints. Bounded rationality recognises limits to information, time and processing ability that can lead to satisficing.
en.definition: Rational choice assumes consistent preferences and utility maximisation subject to constraints. Bounded rationality recognises limits to information, time and processing ability that can lead to satisficing.
causalChain: Many options must be compared
search and calculation are costly
consumers adopt simplifying rules or satisfactory options
misconceptions: Bounded rationality does not mean consumers have no goals or choose randomly.
examApplication: Use a concrete decision to explain the gap between assumptions and observed behaviour.
summary: Rational choice assumes consistent preferences and utility maximisation subject to constraints. Bounded rationality recognises limits to information, time and processing ability that can lead to satisficing.
Bounded rationality does not mean consumers have no goals or choose randomly.
en.explanation:
Many options must be compared.  search and calculation are costly.  consumers adopt simplifying rules or satisfactory options.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: a phone buyer cannot compare every attribute of every model. They set a budget and minimum battery life, then choose the first acceptable model. This saves decision costs without necessarily maximising modelled utility.

Bounded rationality does not mean consumers have no goals or choose randomly.

Use a concrete decision to explain the gap between assumptions and observed behaviour.

zh-CN.title: 行为偏差与助推
zh-CN.takeaway: 锚定、损失厌恶、现在偏好及默认选项等可改变选择；助推通过调整选择环境影响行为，同时保留选择自由。
zh-CN.definition: 锚定、损失厌恶、现在偏好及默认选项等可改变选择；助推通过调整选择环境影响行为，同时保留选择自由。
causalChain: 注意力与判断受到呈现方式影响

注意力与判断受到呈现方式影响。默认或框架改变心理参照。选择在价格未变时也可改变。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：退休储蓄从主动加入改为默认加入但允许退出，可能提高参与率。默认选项不是强制。评价时应讨论退出是否容易、受益者是谁及是否存在操纵风险。

en.title: Behavioural biases and nudges
en.takeaway: Anchoring, loss aversion, present bias and defaults can influence choices. A nudge changes choice architecture while preserving freedom to choose.
en.definition: Anchoring, loss aversion, present bias and defaults can influence choices. A nudge changes choice architecture while preserving freedom to choose.

Presentation influences attention and judgement.  defaults or framing alter reference points.  choices can change even without a price change.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: pension saving changes from opt-in to default enrolment with an opt-out. Participation may rise. A default is not compulsion. Evaluate ease of opting out, who benefits and potential manipulation.

A nudge is not a tax or prohibition; policies restricting choice require a different classification.

Use a concrete decision to explain the gap between assumptions and observed behaviour.

弹性是百分比之比，不是曲线斜率，也不是数量变化除以价格变化。

弹性是百分比之比，不是曲线斜率，也不是数量变化除以价格变化。

en.definition: PED measures the responsiveness of quantity demanded to own-price changes: percentage change in quantity demanded divided by percentage change in price. Classification normally uses its absolute value.

Illustrative example: price rises 10% and quantity demanded falls 20%, so PED is -2, with magnitude two: elastic. State whether base-period or midpoint percentages are used and do not mix denominators within a calculation.

zh-CN.title: 供给价格弹性 PES

PES 衡量供给量反应，不衡量需求变化或供给移动。

en.title: Price elasticity of supply
en.takeaway: PES equals percentage change in quantity supplied divided by percentage change in price and measures producers' quantity response to a price change.
en.definition: PES equals percentage change in quantity supplied divided by percentage change in price and measures producers' quantity response to a price change.

Price changes incentives to produce.  input and capacity limits determine feasible expansion.  compare percentage quantity and price changes.

Illustrative example: price rises 10% and quantity supplied rises 5%, so PES=0.5: inelastic. Completely fixed immediate output gives a vertical supply curve, but not all short-run supply is perfectly inelastic.

PES measures quantity supplied response, not a demand change or a supply shift.

zh-CN.title: PES、产能与时间
zh-CN.takeaway: 闲置产能、库存、投入可移动性、生产周期和调整时间决定供给对价格的反应程度。
zh-CN.definition: 闲置产能、库存、投入可移动性、生产周期和调整时间决定供给对价格的反应程度。

生产可迅速扩张
供给反应较大且 PES 通常较高

时间更长通常提高 PES，但不是无条件保证。
zh-CN.explanation:
可动用库存或闲置机器。生产可迅速扩张。供给反应较大且 PES 通常较高。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：印刷厂有空闲机器，可迅速响应价格上涨；果园需要多年才能增加成熟果树。长期投入更可调整，供给通常更富有弹性，但土地和生态约束仍可存在。

时间更长通常提高 PES，但不是无条件保证。

en.title: PES, capacity and time
en.takeaway: Spare capacity, inventories, factor mobility, production periods and adjustment time determine how readily supply responds to price.
en.definition: Spare capacity, inventories, factor mobility, production periods and adjustment time determine how readily supply responds to price.

production expands quickly

Inventories or idle machines are available.  production expands quickly.  quantity response is larger and PES is normally higher.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: a printer with idle machines can respond quickly to higher prices, while an orchard needs years to grow mature trees. Long-run input flexibility normally raises elasticity, but land and ecological limits may persist.

More time normally increases PES but does not guarantee it under every constraint.

Use spare capacity and adjustment time to explain supply responsiveness.

zh-CN.title: PES 的计算与政策含义
zh-CN.takeaway: 判断政策的数量效应需要供给弹性；数量反应弱时，刺激需求更可能推高价格而非显著扩大产量。

en.title: PES calculations and policy implications

en.title: Characteristics of public goods
en.takeaway: A pure public good is both non-rival and non-excludable: one person's use does not reduce availability to others, and non-payers are difficult to exclude.
en.definition: A pure public good is both non-rival and non-excludable: one person's use does not reduce availability to others, and non-payers are difficult to exclude.

Illustrative example: national defence generally protects one more resident without reducing protection for others and cannot easily exclude non-payers. A congested road is rival at peak times, so it cannot always be treated as a pure public good.

en.title: Free riding and underprovision
en.takeaway: Free riding means enjoying benefits without paying. Non-excludability encourages concealed willingness to pay, making cost recovery difficult and causing underprovision.
en.definition: Free riding means enjoying benefits without paying. Non-excludability encourages concealed willingness to pay, making cost recovery difficult and causing underprovision.

misconceptions: Simply raising the price cannot solve free riding when non-payers still receive benefits.

Simply raising the price cannot solve free riding when non-payers still receive benefits.
en.explanation:
Users can benefit without payment.  voluntary contributions are insufficient.  private financing may fail to cover production costs.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: neighbourhood lighting benefits every household, including non-payers. Even if combined benefit exceeds installation cost, voluntary charging may fail. Taxes or community rules can coordinate financing without guaranteeing spending efficiency.

Simply raising the price cannot solve free riding when non-payers still receive benefits.

Underprovision supports a case for intervention but does not prove every government project is worthwhile.

en.definition: TR=P×Q, AR=TR/Q and MR=ΔTR/ΔQ. Economic profit deducts explicit and implicit opportunity costs. Normal profit is included in economic cost, so zero economic profit can sustain production.
